Honestly, Rust is the best game I’ve ever played. I can’t even explain how many unforgettable memories I’ve made playing this game. The good times, the bad times, the betrayals, the unexpected friendships, the intense fights, and all those nights spent playing with no sense of time passing.

I wish I had more time to play, but life gets busy and I can’t play like I used to. It honestly hurts a little knowing I can’t spend as much time in this game anymore.

I’ll always have a special place in my heart for Rust. Maybe one day I’ll come back and experience it all over again.

Thank you, Rust. ❤️

Rust scratches an itch that no other PvP game can. I genuinely love playing this game, but it desperately needs another serious performance overhaul. It's honestly amazing how a game that's been around for this long still struggles to push past 60–100 FPS on most servers unless you're running a newer CPU or one with 3D V-Cache. I can play plenty of other modern titles and comfortably push 150–200+ FPS, yet Rust is one of the only games I play where I'm lucky to consistently break 120 FPS. And apparently, because my CPU doesn't have that magical "3D cache," I'm just out of luck.What's even more frustrating is that it feels like nearly every major update makes performance progressively worse. I understand Rust is a demanding game, especially with large maps, massive player counts, and player-built structures, but at some point, optimization needs to become a bigger priority.I'm not expecting 300+ FPS on a populated server, but I also don't think it's unreasonable to expect consistently good performance on hardware that's still more than capable of running modern games.Please, Face punch, give Rust the performance overhaul it desperately needs. I'd love to enjoy this game without having to sell my organs on the black market just to afford a new motherboard, ram and CPU.I love Rust, but I shouldn't need to build an entirely new PC every few years just to keep up with its declining performance. (This is also the reason I don't have more hours because my performance is so unbelievably terrible that it makes it really unfun to play)

This is a game you play when you have no job or no school. You can't have a life.

The combat system is amazing and so is the exploring. 

When it comes to customization, I really love the skins. ESPECIALLY the partnerships they do for free skins. 

This game has lots and lots of updates and is very well maintained. Always adding new spots to explore or weapons to try. 

It is a very unique game where you can raid/kill other players or team up with them, which is fun. But when you get to understanding the types of people that are playing, you'll soon realize that you're mostly gonna get betrayed, unless you betray them first.

To get basically anywhere, you'll need to grind A LOT. Which I don't even recommend because you'll probably wake up the next day with nothing. If I were you, I would watch a youtube video to understand and enjoy what the game is about. Other than that, not worth the time.
